integrity.claim_scope: Exact projective stabilizer and harmonic-chord description for the displayed arrangement.
integrity.proof_basis: Component-degree rigidity, the quadratic parametrization of the conic, harmonic cross-ratio, and exact finite group enumeration.
integrity.unproved_limits: No claim about automorphisms of resolutions, complements, or historical priority beyond the inspected sources.

limitations: The theorem determines only the embedded projective stabilizer of the reduced plane arrangement.
The lead paper cites a 1992 thesis as containing some related conic-line examples; exact equation-level overlap with this arrangement could not be verified from accessible full text.
title: Harmonic chord symmetry of Pokora’s six-line conic arrangement
